Alisa: quick heads-up, onboarding Ventus LoRA merge (ventus/lora-v2) on int8; quick-eval shows amount tokenization regressions (spaced digits, dropped $).

Mohit: evalpack id? paste a couple failing lines.

Alisa: ventus-qc-2026-03. CI summary: QA 92.1%->88.4%, token anomalies=12, top failure: amount normalization/currency drop.

Dana: sounds like token id shift after graft. Any special token inserts?

Alisa: merge diff shows new special token inserted by adapter (###AMOUNT) which likely shifted indices. I didn't run remap.

Sam: try re-running quick-eval with a tok-remap and also disable KV cache to rule out caching.

Alisa: running with --tok-remap remap-v2.json and --no-kv-cache now. Command and logs attached. Partial: 
- sample 127: "Invoice total is 1 0 0 0" -> parsed as spaced digits
- sample 198: "$120" -> "120"

Mohit: yep, multi-digit tokens split. Remap should restore contiguous digit tokens.

Alisa: remap run results: QA 92.1%->91.8% (-0.3), token anomalies 1 (was 12), latency ~+3% on int8, no KV-cache impact.

Sam: ok action items: add remap generation into LoRA merge pipeline, a post-merge token-histogram sanity check against common numeric tokens, and a CI smoke test option to run tok-remap during merges. I'll open PR.

Dana: also add a short docs blurb about "special-token insertions during adapter grafts" and link the PR.

Mohit: suggestion: upload token-id histograms and top-100 freq snapshot to S3 for customer forensics.

Sam: pushed branch merge/ventus-remap-84321, pinging @Mohit for review.

eval-bot: re-run 84321-r2 finished: QA 92.1%->92.0% (-0.1), token anomalies 0, perf/cost acceptable. Verdict: safe to onboard once remap step added.
